hydration.title: Support steady hydration
hydration.detail: Build regular fluids into your day and follow any fluid advice from your oncology team.

goals.title: Drink three cups of water before lunch
Refill your water bottle once today

movement.title: Make movement manageable
movement.detail: Choose a gentle activity at a pace that feels safe; discuss changes in activity with your care team.

goals.title: Do five minutes of comfortable stretching

rest.title: Protect rest and recovery
rest.detail: Try a consistent wind-down routine and mention persistent sleep or stress concerns to your clinician.

goals.title: Start a screen-free wind-down 30 minutes before bed
Take five slow breathing breaks today

nutrition.title: Plan nourishing meals
nutrition.detail: Use foods you tolerate well and ask a dietitian or oncology team for personalised bowel-symptom advice.

goals.title: Eat a banana or another tolerated fruit today
Add one tolerated vegetable to a meal

maintenance.title: Continue your healthy routine
maintenance.detail: Keep tracking the habits that are working and bring questions to your next care visit.

goals.title: Write down one food or habit that felt good today
